vintage-noir-comic-panel-black-panther-d.title: Vintage Noir Comic Panel: Black Panther Detective Examines Paw Print
vintage-noir-comic-panel-black-panther-d.description: A gritty, vintage comic book style illustration depicting a sharp-dressed anthropomorphic black panther detective. Wearing a classic fedora and trench coat, the detective crouches in a rain-slicked, dark city alley at night, intently examining a large, mysterious feline paw print embedded in the cobblestone mud with a magnifying glass. The sepia-toned artwork features cross-hatching and aged paper textures, evoking a classic 1940s film noir detective story.
